sources.title: Impliedhomeland/midtrain-bridge-1B-cosine-backbone · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: midtrain-bridge: Pythia-1B / 60B cosine C4 backbone A C4-only 1B-parameter pretraining run to 60B tokens, published with all 17 intermediate checkpoints along the trajectory. This is the W=0 reference arm of a study on when to introduce a new data distribution (code) during pretraining; the checkpoints are the fork points from which code-mixed branches are launched.

sources.title: HyperNova 60B 2605 — Multiverse Computing | AI Flash Report
sources.snippet: HyperNova 60B 2605 is a Major Release AI model from Multiverse Computing, released on May 26, 2026. It has a 131K tokens context window, costs $0.04 per million input tokens, and scores 73.3% on GPQA Diamond.

sources.title: AI-Powered Hiring Intelligence System - GitHub
sources.snippet: AI-Powered Hiring Intelligence System that matches resumes to job descriptions using BERT embeddings & cosine similarity. Features ML-based hiring prediction, candidate ranking, fairness/bias analysis across groups, and an interactive Streamlit dashboard for real-time resume scoring.
